topics.name: Runner Execution
topics.purpose: Define each Routine execution as a transient runner identity carrying routine snapshot/ref, caller context, current step, state, bounds and result provenance.

semantics.identity_rule: Each run has a unique runtime runner/execution identity.
semantics.definition_rule: Runner references the exact Routine definition/version/snapshot being executed.
semantics.step_rule: Current/completed step state is explicit runtime state.
semantics.bound_rule: Runner has finite timeout/resource/concurrency bounds according to policy.
semantics.result_rule: Runner result is inert data plus execution provenance.
semantics.cleanup_rule: All terminal states converge on deterministic cleanup.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions and runner executions are separate canonical identities; runners execute explicit ordered routine content through the normal governed dispatch boundary.

hard_gates.condition: two runs share ambiguous runtime identity
routine definition mutates implicitly during active run

references.purpose: Runner executes a specific Routine definition.
Each effectful step uses governed dispatch.
